$comment: What this repository contributes to a running stack, and what a check may
believe about it. Everything under `checked` is proved against this
repository by internal/manifest, by building and running the binary.
Everything under `declared` is a statement nobody can verify and carries
distribution: not distributed yet: no tag. ghcr.io/taipanbox/keyryx is published by .github/workflows/release.yml on the first v* tag push (linux/amd64 and linux/arm64, signed keyless with cosign, SBOM and build-provenance attestation attached)

role.value: key custody and an independent witness for the agent-governance record, off every request path
role.why: a sentence about purpose is not a property of the source

witness_not_built.value: the witness role is not built in this version and refuses to start with exit 2
witness_not_built.why: a witness that came up and witnessed nothing would read as a record nobody rewrote; it arrives in its own pull request

socket_dir_conditional.value: KEYRYX_SOCKET_DIR is required once a consumer in KEYRYX_POLICY authenticates by socket, and KEYRYX_K8S_ISSUERS once one authenticates by a projected service-account token
socket_dir_conditional.why: the manifest's required/optional split cannot express a variable required only by what another one says; internal/config holds the conditional rule and its tests

admin_keys_default.value: unset: rotate and revoke refuse every call (403)
admin_keys_default.why: optional because a deployment may rotate by restarting with a new policy; fail closed when unset, never open
